meta.promptText: I want to buy running shoes under ₹3000 in India. Which ones should I get?

response.text:
Finding a reliable pair of running shoes under **₹3,000** in India requires balancing durability, cushioning, and grip. While premium brands like Nike and ASICS mostly start above ₹4,000–₹5,000, brands like **Decathlon, Adidas, Puma, and Campus** offer exceptional value-for-money entry-level running shoes in this budget.

The top recommendations for running shoes under ₹3,000 are categorized below by what they do best:

---

### 1. Best for Regular Jogging & Durability: Decathlon Kalenji Jogflow 190.1

* **Approximate Price:** ₹2,499[www.decathlon.in](https://www.decathlon.in/c/running-shoes-25400#:~:text=Kalenji%20Men%20Running%20Shoes%20Superior%20Grip%20Cushioned,Gender%20Category%20Size.%20Men%20Women%20Girls%20Boys.)
* **Why buy it:** Decathlon is unmatched in the budget performance segment. The Jogflow 190.1 is specifically designed for regular runners (up to 20 km a week).[www.decathlon.in](https://www.decathlon.in/c/running-shoes-25400#:~:text=Kalenji%20Men%20Running%20Shoes%20Superior%20Grip%20Cushioned,Gender%20Category%20Size.%20Men%20Women%20Girls%20Boys.) It features good shock absorption (CS technology in the heel), a breathable mesh upper, and a flexible sole that handles road conditions exceptionally well.
* **Best For:** Beginners looking for a dedicated, long-lasting shoe strictly for running and jogging.

### 2. Best for Lightweight Performance & Styling: Adidas (Entry-Level Performance Line)

* **Approximate Price:** ₹2,200 – ₹2,999 (frequently discounted on the official Adidas India site, Myntra, or Flipkart)
* **Models to look for:** Look out for models like the **Adidas Run Steady, Rayrun, or select Duramo variants** on sale.
* **Why buy it:** Adidas entry-level running shoes offer great heel lockdown, sleek styling, and reliable rubber outsoles. They double up nicely as casual streetwear or gym trainers alongside light road runs.
* **Best For:** Those who want a branded shoe that balances casual aesthetics with running utility.

### 3. Best for Cushioning & Comfort: Puma (Conduct Pro / Fusion Pro / Galaxis Pro series)

* **Approximate Price:** ₹2,000 – ₹2,999 (during online sales on Myntra, Flipkart, or Puma.in)
* **Why buy it:** Puma frequently discounts its mid-tier sports shoes down to the sub-₹3,000 bracket. Models in their Pro series feature comfortable foam cushioning, bold styling, and breathable mesh upper builds that keep feet cool during workouts.
* **Best For:** Runners who prefer a softer, plush underfoot feel and modern styling.

### 4. Best Budget Indian Brand: Campus Activewear (Oxyfresh / Running Series)

* **Approximate Price:** ₹1,300 – ₹2,200
* **Why buy it:** Campus has grown massively in India for offering high-utility, lightweight running and walking shoes at a fraction of international brand costs. They feature responsive cushioning and are very pocket-friendly if you are on a tight budget.
* **Best For:** Value-seekers who want maximum comfort and usability for under ₹2,000.

---

### Quick Buying Tips for Sub-₹3,000 Shoes:

* **Check the Outsole:** Ensure the shoe has rubber patches on high-wear areas (heel and toe). Cheap shoes with foam-only bottoms tend to wear out within a couple of months of running on Indian asphalt.
* **Size Up:** Running shoes generally fit tighter than regular casual shoes. Consider buying half a size or one full size up (especially for brands like Adidas and Puma) to give your toes room to expand.
* **Where to buy:** Keep an eye on **Myntra, Ajio, Decathlon, and Flipkart**, where seasonal sales routinely drop the prices of branded entry-level running shoes into this sweet spot.
